releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.2.1

- Expanded workouts now show their complete description instead of stopping after eight lines.
- Long descriptions use the menu's existing vertical scrolling.
- Recognized strength and mobility exercises now include one-click animated demonstration links inside Bike Sync.
- Existing connections saved by earlier Bike Sync versions are recognized after updating.
- An explicitly approved managed workout can receive description-only corrections while manual events remain protected.
